title: Junior QA Tester
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Junior QA Tester for our Quality Assurance team (Remote (EU)).

What you will do
- Plan and run tests for new features
- Report and track defects with developers
- Build and maintain automated test suites

What you bring
- No professional experience needed; internships and personal projects count
- Solid working knowledge of Regression Testing, API Testing, Selenium, Java, Playwright and Test Planning

Nice to have
- Performance Testing and SQL
